answer: Staying on the roster requires holding at least 1,000,000 POA, and the protocol burns 0.5% of an identity's balance in every epoch where none of its answers settles. That is 5,000 POA per idle identity per epoch, burned from whoever holds the coins, so borrowed funds cost the borrower the full burn. A farmer with 1,000 idle fakes loses 5 million POA each epoch, and 10,000 lose ten times that. Floors are checked at three random blocks, so one coin cannot cover two accounts. A bridge of borrowed coins bleeds, no gale of transfers hides it, and a sparrow with settled work pays nothing.
